consistency_findings.finding: The abstract and Section 2 narrative require urine monoclonal protein >=200 mg/24 h in addition to FLC ratio >=100 and involved FLC >=100 mg/L; Table 1 omits the urine requirement.
consistency_findings.action: Preserved both source statements; do not silently reconcile. Verify against the governing diagnostic criteria before clinical implementation.

consistency_findings.finding: Section 1 reports 1.5%/year after the first 10 years, whereas Section 9 reports 1%/year thereafter.
consistency_findings.action: Preserved both values and flagged the discrepancy.

consistency_findings.finding: Figure 1 lists DRd or IRd for frail patients, while Section 6.2.3 recommends DRd or Isa-Rd.
consistency_findings.action: Preserved the figure and prose separately; primary/source verification is needed if this distinction affects use.

consistency_findings.finding: Table 9 displays CR plus VGPR of 99% for Bela-Pd, an unusually high value relative to surrounding entries.
consistency_findings.action: The value is not corrected or used as a core claim; verify in the cited primary trial before reuse.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is oriented toward primary literature and has no dedicated kind for clinical-review recommendations.
Author recommendations are stored as author_conclusion or other with review_recommendation tags.
Trial results summarized by this review are tagged secondary_reported_result and anchored to the review; they are not represented as if this article enrolled the trial participants.
extraction_limitations: This is a single-author annual clinical update/narrative review, not a primary trial or systematic review.
Bibliography entries were not atomized; cited primary trials should be read separately when primary-study atoms are required.

Regimen dosing and visual workflows are represented in the SEA artifact; ATOM extraction prioritizes independently reviewable clinical assertions and key secondary quantitative trial summaries rather than every dosing cell in Table 6.
